description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
